conditions: Titania Prime is vaulted. Aya cannot buy her relics until Varzia includes Titania in a future Prime Resurgence rotation.
Aya is untradeable, but it has no cap and remains after the rotation ends.
Tier-5 Deimos has a 43.48% final-stage Aya reward. Completing bonus objectives lets the final stage roll twice.
bonuses: Bank Aya now, then spend it as soon as Titania returns to Varzia's stock.
Avoid Hepit and relic packs as dedicated Aya farms; they are much weaker or consume valuable standing.

disclosures.title: the calendar is the farm
disclosures.body: Varzia changes stock every 28 days at 18:00 UTC and Digital Extremes does not publish the schedule far ahead. Check the live Prime Resurgence rotation before committing; while Titania is absent, stockpile Aya or use player trading.

conditions: These four relics are Varzia's Titania rotation stock; buy only these rather than the wider historical relic list.
Prime Resurgence relics are Varzia-only. Their ordinary mission-drop entries are replaced by Aya, so missions cannot produce them.
Buy enough before the rotation closes. Vaulted relics are tradeable and never expire.
bonuses: Varzia is also available from the Orbiter Relic Segment and the Prime Resurgence Market tab.
If Aya is the constraint, run a rad-stagger with friends: use one person's relic at a time, then buy another only if needed.

disclosures.title: the Systems relic is the budget risk
disclosures.body: Lith T11 is the only listed Varzia relic containing Titania Prime Systems, and it is Rare. There is no pity system; keep Aya available for a long streak.

conditions: Refine Lith T11 to Radiant (100 Void Traces) and run a four-player radshare: four Radiant relics give a 34.4% chance of at least one Rare reward.
Run Lith G11 Intact in a four-player share; its Common Chassis already has roughly a 69% squad chance, so save the traces.
Collect 10 Reactant before extracting. Use arranged shares, not public squads, for Radiant relics.
bonuses: Host with the exact relic name, such as 'LF Lith T11 RAD'; the Relic Segment search may not show Resurgence relics.
Choose a squadmate's duplicate Titania reward when it appears; you keep the part and they receive extra Void Traces.

conditions: Components build in parallel; the final frame takes 72 hours. Keep a free Warframe slot for the claim.
The resource gates are Argon Crystal, Nitain Extract, Tellurium, Neural Sensors and Control Modules.
Argon decays after 24 hours, so farm it only once the component blueprints are in the Foundry queue.
